# Sanjay Sinha — AI & Data Scientist

> Data Scientist at Michelin specializing in Enterprise RAG systems,
> Azure OpenAI, LlamaIndex, LangChain, and production AI architectures.
> Graduate of Chennai Mathematical Institute (M.Sc Data Science, 2024).

## Core Competencies

- Enterprise RAG architecture: LlamaIndex, LlamaCloud, LangChain, Qdrant, Mistral AI
- Azure AI: Azure OpenAI (GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini), Azure AI Foundry, Azure DevOps
- Production infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, FastAPI, OpenTelemetry
- Mathematical modeling: simulation, ML forecasting, systems modeling
- Security: ForgeRock OAuth, zero-trust architectures, secure LLM pipelines
- Observability: OpenTelemetry tracing for LLM pipelines

## Projects

### Enterprise RAG System (Michelin)
Lead architect for Michelin's primary production RAG system. Implemented
advanced model routing between GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini, reducing latency
from 10-12s to 6-7s with cost optimization. Integrates LlamaCloud parsing,
OpenTelemetry observability, and ForgeRock OAuth security.

### EV Market Simulation (Michelin France)
Combines ML forecasting with mathematical simulation for the French EV market.
Processes historical data to forecast trends and simulates car parc evolution
under 10+ theoretical scenarios with 95% accuracy. Stack: FastAPI, Streamlit.

### DevOps & Jira Agents (Azure AI Foundry)
Multi-agent system built on Azure AI Foundry that autonomously interacts with
Jira and Azure DevOps via REST API. Lists issues, fetches build details, and
surfaces pipeline commits. Delivers 80% time savings in developer operations.
